rules.v: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
rules.vi: Instrumen khusus dengan hak lebih sempit, atau hanya pasal tertentu dari hukum umum
rules.n: Domestic workers benefit only from Labour Law articles listed in art. 2 (contract, wages, leave, gratuity, court-fee exemption, non-discrimination since 2018).

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required, no language rule
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
rules.n: Standard tripartite contract (agency, worker, employer) plus a contract between worker and employer; BHD 200-500 penalty for non-compliance; language rule not stated.
No minimum wage (the minimum wage covers only Bahraini public-sector workers).

rules.v: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
rules.vi: Pembayaran berkala wajib, tanpa pengaman lain
rules.n: Monthly payment; domestic workers are outside the Wages Protection Scheme unless the employer opts in.
rules.s: Law 36/2012 art. 2; Decision 68/2019; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.v: No limit and no daily rest rule
rules.vi: Tidak ada batas dan aturan istirahat harian

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
rules.vi: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
rules.s: Penal Code art. 395; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
rules.n: The standard contract requires decent housing, privacy, food, clothing, safety, medical care and regular contact with family.
rules.s: LMRA standard contract; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Change of employer at any time with permission; without it, only with LMRA approval. Domestic workers have one week (others 30 days) to contest an absconding report.

rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
rules.n: No person may take money or any benefit from a worker for a work permit, employment or keeping the job; prison of 3 months to 1 year and/or BHD 1,000-2,000, aggravated for domestic-worker permits and multiplied by the number of workers.

LMRA licence with Bahraini ownership, approved contract templates and a BHD 10,000 guarantee (which compensates employers only); offices placing women domestic workers must provide temporary housing supervised by a woman.

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
rules.n: Ministry settlement or direct LMRA filing with translation and document help; no filing fee; hearing within two months.

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
rules.n: Compulsory private health insurance includes domestic workers; end-of-service gratuity applies; sick leave, injury and maternity not specified; optional employer insurance.
rules.s: Law 23/2018 art. 26; Law 36/2012 art. 2; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum
rules.n: LMRA Expatriate Protection Unit shelter for trafficking victims; hotline 995; general criminal law.

rules.v: May form and join trade unions
rules.vi: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat
rules.n: All workers, including domestic workers, may join and in principle form trade unions.

help.de: Advice, legal and medical help and repatriation support for migrant workers. Office hours Sunday to Thursday, 8am to 1pm. Its shelter closed in 2019.
help.di: Nasihat, bantuan hukum dan medis, serta dukungan pemulangan bagi pekerja migran. Jam kantor Minggu sampai Kamis, pukul 08.00 sampai 13.00. Rumah aman mereka tutup pada 2019.

help.de: Bahrain's Labour Market Regulatory Authority runs a 24-hour hotline in several languages for workers who are abused, trafficked or not paid. The center also offers shelter.
help.di: Otoritas Pasar Kerja Bahrain mengelola saluran 24 jam dalam beberapa bahasa bagi pekerja yang dianiaya, diperdagangkan atau tidak dibayar. Pusat ini juga menyediakan tempat penampungan.
